macOS 的鎖定畫面由系統進程繪製，第三方 App 改不到 —— 我們試過直接: macOS draws the lock screen in a system process; third-party apps cannot change it. We tried writing the wallpaper store (Index.plist) and impersonating Apple's aerials — the system reverts within seconds. The feature was removed rather than shipped half-working.
